### Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Retatrutide improves cardiovascular risk biomarkers in obesity](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42608321/)** — *PubMed*
  * Eli Lilly's retatrutide, a GIP/GLP-1/glucagon receptor triagonist, demonstrated significant clinical improvements in key cardiovascular risk biomarkers in adults with obesity, regardless of type 2 diabetes status.

* **[Global genome-wide association study identifies 383 loci for heart failure](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.13.26360411)** — *bioRxiv*
  * A multi-ancestry GWAS encompassing over 4.4 million individuals (including 345,687 heart failure cases) identified 383 loci (166 novel) and 568 genes associated with heart failure and its subtypes (HFpEF and HFrEF).
  * The analysis highlights druggable targets and supports potential indication expansion for aldosterone synthase inhibitors (`CYP11B2`) and type II activin receptor antagonists (`ACVR2A`) in heart failure management.

* **[Non-invasive urinary metabolite panel predicts survival in malignant mesothelioma](https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.09.23.25336488)** — *bioRxiv*
  * A composite of four urinary metabolites—creatine riboside (CR), N-acetylneuraminic acid (NANA), cortisol sulfate (CS), and cholestane pentol (CP)—positively correlated with a validated 48-gene poor-prognosis transcriptomic signature in mesothelioma patients (`n = 95`).
  * Overall survival declined progressively with the accumulation of elevated metabolites, suggesting utility as a non-invasive prognostic tool for this aggressive malignancy.

* **[Tasso+ capillary blood collection matches venous plasma for key neurodegenerative biomarkers](https://doi.org/10.1101/2026.08.13.26360406)** — *bioRxiv*
  * A clinical comparison (`n = 83`) evaluated the Tasso+ minimally invasive upper-arm capillary blood collection device against traditional venipuncture using the NULISA central nervous system biomarker panel.
  * Direct correlation for p-tau217 was restored by utilizing a brain-derived (BD)-p-tau217/BD-p-tau181 ratio, validating capillary collection for decentralized Alzheimer's trial monitoring.

* **[Multi-omic plasma profiling maps proteomic signatures of Alzheimer's progression](https://doi.org/10.1101/2026.08.14.26360394)** — *bioRxiv*
  * A multi-omic linear modeling study (`n = 484`) mapped systemic proteomic signatures associated with five standard blood biomarkers (Aβ₄₂/₄₀, p-tau181, p-tau217, GFAP, and NfL) across more than 6,000 proteins.
  * The resulting models resolve overlapping and distinct biological pathways of early progression, providing a continuous molecular trajectory prior to cognitive symptom onset.

### Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Non-ablative stereotactic radiosurgery demonstrates safety and efficacy in treatment-resistant depression](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.13.26360283)** — *bioRxiv*
  * A single-center, randomized, double-masked pilot trial (`n = 9`) evaluated bilateral subgenual anterior cingulate cortex (sgACC) radiomodulation using non-ablative stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) at doses of 15, 20, or 25 Gy.
  * The trial met safety endpoints, with transient grade 1 dizziness as the sole treatment-related adverse event, and showed a 48.5% mean reduction in MADRS at week 4 (67% response rate, 44% remission rate) that was sustained to week 12.

* **[Biotech]** **[Conbercept eye drops show safety and early efficacy in corneal neovascularization](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42608019/)** — *PubMed*
  * Results from Phase I/IIa clinical trials demonstrate favorable pharmacokinetics, safety, and preliminary therapeutic efficacy of conbercept eye drops for patients with corneal neovascularization.

* **[Oregon's regulated psilocybin program shows real-world psychiatric improvements](https://doi.org/10.1101/2026.02.18.26346580)** — *bioRxiv*
  * A prospective, naturalistic study (March 2024–April 2025) of adults undergoing supervised psilocybin services under the Oregon state-regulated model showed significant self-reported improvements in depression, anxiety, and well-being at 30 days post-session.

### Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Biotech]** **[argenx blockbuster Vyvgart Hytrulo hits primary endpoint in Phase III myositis study](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/argenx-phase-3-data-vyvgart-IMNM-DM/828025/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * argenx announced positive top-line data from its Phase III ALKIVIA trial evaluating subcutaneous Vyvgart Hytrulo (efgartigimod alfa and hyaluronidase-qvux) in patients with myositis, a rare autoimmune muscle disease.
  * The study met its primary endpoint, demonstrating statistically significant improvements over placebo across two subsets of the disease as evaluated by the Total Improvement Score (TIS).

* **[Big Pharma]** **[AstraZeneca terminates Phase III trial of bispecific volrustomig in lung cancer](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/astrazeneca-discontinues-trial-volrustomig-lung-cancer/827999/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * AstraZeneca is discontinuing its Phase III eVOLVE-Lung02 trial evaluating the PD-1/CTLA-4 bispecific antibody volrustomig combined with chemotherapy in patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with low PD-L1 expression.
  * An interim analysis by the Independent Data Monitoring Committee (IDMC) concluded that the combination was unlikely to meet its dual primary endpoints or demonstrate a survival benefit compared to standard-of-care Keytruda plus chemotherapy, resulting in the trial being halted for futility.

* **[Biotech]** **[EyePoint's Duravyu fails primary endpoint in pivotal wet AMD trial](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/eyepoint-trial-results-durayvu-wet-amd-stock/828022/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * EyePoint Pharmaceuticals' sustained-release insert Duravyu (vorolanib) failed to meet its primary efficacy endpoint in the Phase III LUGANO trial of ~400 patients with wet age-related macular degeneration (wet AMD).
  * Duravyu failed to maintain visual acuity compared to standard-of-care aflibercept, causing the company's market value to fall by nearly $1 billion, though the company prepares for the second Phase III LUCIA trial readout in Q4 and anticipates a potential 1H 2027 NDA filing.

* **[Biotech]** **[Summit and Akeso's ivonescimab tumor-progression benefit narrows](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/17/biotech-news-akeso-summit-ivonescimabs-worsening-tumor-progression-benefit/)** — *STAT+*
  * Recent clinical updates for the lung cancer candidate ivonescimab (PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody) suggest a narrowing tumor-progression benefit over time, tempering initial enthusiasm for the candidate.

* **[Ticagrelor vs. Prasugrel comparative effectiveness in ACS patients](https://doi.org/10.1101/2026.08.13.26360416)** — *bioRxiv*
  * A multinational retrospective cohort study spanning 7 claims and EHR databases compared the P2Y12 inhibitors ticagrelor and prasugrel in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) undergoing their first PCI.
  * The study used propensity score stratification to evaluate 1-year major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) and net adverse clinical events (NACE) to resolve ongoing clinical trial discrepancies.

### Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **[BMS discloses Excaliber-RRMM data in Zenbexus label release](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2089287931450020107)** — *@JacobPlieth*
  * The FDA label release for Bristol Myers Squibb's Zenbexus marks the first formal disclosure of clinical data from the Excaliber-RRMM trial in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.

* **[Biotech]** **[UroGen Pharma submits NDA for bladder cancer therapy UGN-103](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2089321786114445646)** — *@BioStocks*
  * UroGen has submitted a New Drug Application (NDA) to the FDA for UGN-103, an investigational formulation for the treatment of recurrent low-grade intermediate-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (LG-IR-NMIBC).

* **[Biotech]** **[Europe pulls Tavneos over clinical trial integrity concerns](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/17/biotech-news-akeso-summit-ivonescimabs-worsening-tumor-progression-benefit/)** — *STAT+*
  * European regulatory authorities have withdrawn the marketing authorization for the C3a receptor antagonist Tavneos (avacopan) following investigations raising concerns over trial data integrity.

* **[Biotech]** **[FDA grants Fast Track Designation to PIKTOR combination](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2089316148198142137)** — *@BioStocks*
  * Designation covers PIKTOR plus paclitaxel for biomarker-selected advanced endometrial cancer.

* **[FDA issues draft guidance on ANDA vs. 505(b)(2) abbreviated pathways](http://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/determining-whether-submit-anda-or-505b2-application-0)** — *FDA*
  * The FDA released an updated draft guidance titled "Determining Whether to Submit an ANDA or a 505(b)(2) Application," revising its May 2019 version to help developers navigate abbreviated drug approval pathways.
  * This effort is part of the FDA's broader Drug Competition Action Plan (DCAP) to enhance generic drug review efficiency and align with GDUFA III reauthorization metrics.

* **[FDA issues new draft and final guidance documents for generics and biosimilars](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/guidances-drugs/newly-added-guidance-documents)** — *FDA*
  * Key regulatory documents added include *Container Closure Systems for Human Drugs and Biological Products* (Draft, Aug 14, 2026), *Considerations for Container Closure Systems and Device Constituent Parts for Biosimilar and Interchangeable Biosimilar Products* (Draft, Aug 3, 2026), and *Assessing Adhesion/Irritation and Sensitization Potential of Transdermal and Topical Delivery Systems for ANDAs* (Final and Draft, Aug 3, 2026).

* **[American Regent and Sunny Pharmtech initiate voluntary nationwide drug recalls](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/american-regent-inc-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-one-lot-papaverine-hydrochloride-injection)** — *FDA*
  * American Regent recalled one lot of Papaverine Hydrochloride Injection (60 mg/2 mL) due to visible particulate matter.
  * Sunny Pharmtech voluntarily recalled three lots of Cyclophosphamide for Injection (1 g/vial and 2 g/vial) due to the presence of steel particulate matter.

### Business & Strategy

* **[Big Pharma]** **[Sanofi announces layoffs in Massachusetts following Blueprint Medicines integration](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/17/sanofi-layoffs-mass-blueprint-medicines/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+*
  * Sanofi is cutting 229 jobs in Massachusetts, exactly one year after closing its $9.1 billion acquisition of oncology-focused Blueprint Medicines.

* **[Biotech]** **[Slate Medicines and Fulcrum Therapeutics announce reverse merger](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/slate-fulcrum-reverse-merger-migraine-anti-pacap/828007/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Slate Medicines, a biotech focused on migraine therapeutics, is merging with Fulcrum Therapeutics in an all-stock reverse merger.
  * The deal follows Fulcrum’s decision to halt development of its lead sickle-cell candidate pociredir due to FDA concerns over secondary hematological malignancies, shifting the combined pipeline focus to Slate's anti-PACAP programs.

* **[UnitedHealth Group under IRS investigation for potential tax avoidance](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/17/unitedhealth-irs-probe-audit-targets-foreign-subsidiary-transfers/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+*
  * The IRS is auditing UnitedHealth Group, focusing on potential tax avoidance related to foreign subsidiary transfers, which could result in significant back-tax liabilities.

### Public Health & Policy

* **[Plasmodium falciparum PX1 mutation linked to drug resistance emerges in Uganda](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04590-5)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Whole-genome sequencing of clinical isolates of *Plasmodium falciparum* in Uganda has revealed rapid positive selection of a `PX1`-associated haplotype that confers reduced susceptibility to standard antimalarials.

* **[Trump administration health updates and RFK Jr. vaccine policy shift](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/17/health-news-everything-the-trump-administration-did-on-health-care/?utm_campaign=rss)** — *STAT+*
  * The administration issued an executive order aimed at remaking the federal vaccine agenda, coinciding with public messaging from Robert F. Kennedy Jr. focusing on "Make America Healthy Again" (MAHA) priorities.

* **[Dementia Trials Accelerator launches to streamline UK trial enrollment](https://doi.org/10.1101/2026.08.14.26359869)** — *bioRxiv*
  * The newly established Dementia Trials Accelerator (DTA) will offer a UK-wide federated platform to search for eligible participants across existing cohorts, alongside a pre-screening service and central plasma/DNA biobank.

* **[Cost-effectiveness analysis supports triple-elimination ANC panels in Nigeria](https://doi.org/10.1101/2026.08.14.26360312)** — *bioRxiv*
  * A deterministic and probabilistic modeling study indicates that adopting a WHO-prequalified single-finger-prick testing panel for HIV, syphilis, and hepatitis B (HBV) in Nigeria's antenatal care (ANC) services would avert 562 of 3,299 vertical transmissions annually.

***

**Worth watching**: The continued regulatory focus on clinical trial data integrity (highlighted by Europe's Tavneos pull), the clinical evolution of bispecifics in lung cancer following AstraZeneca's volrustomig setback, and EyePoint's upcoming Phase 3 LUCIA readout in wet AMD during Q4.

- Biology & Health
    - [Could this change Everything about Vitamin K2 and Calcified Arteries? [New Study]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=STML7Yugs70) -- Physionic
        - The video discusses the mechanism of action of Vitamin K2 in relation to calcified arteries and cardiovascular disease.
        - It examines the results of a new randomized clinical trial investigating the effects of two years of menaquinone-7 (Vitamin K2) supplementation on coronary artery calcification.
        - Reference studies include previous investigations into vitamin K supplementation and the progression of coronary artery calcium in various populations, such as older adults and patients with chronic kidney disease.
- Pure Science
    - [Total Solar Eclipse From Space](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J1WoNuemKOg) -- Veritasium
        - The video documents capturing the 2026 total solar eclipse from the edge of space using ballooning technology in collaboration with the Montana State University NASA Ballooning Team.
        - It explores the mechanics behind solar eclipses, including why the Northern Hemisphere experiences more total solar eclipses and how up to five solar eclipses can occur in a year.
        - It explains specific optical and atmospheric phenomena associated with solar eclipses, such as why the Sun turns white during totality, the origin of a historically faked element, weird shadow behaviors, and the shadow band effect.
